mathematical_meanings: Left image: The open endpoint excludes (3, 2) from the function graph. Right image: The outline is the unit circle in the coordinate plane.
Rationales: The feature marks an ordered pair excluded from the plotted trace in the left image and traces the circumference of a geometric circle in the right image. The hollow circle at the right end of the curve at (3, 2). The blue circle crossing the axes at unit distance from the origin.
